name: Single cell atlas of the human retina - Bipolar cell subclass - scRNA-seq
description: Over 72K bipolar cells derived from scRNA-seq datasets were included in the current atlas, which can be divided into 14 cell types based marker genes.

labels.name: Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Brain,Tonsillar Squamous Cell Carcinoma

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: This label set was generated by the author using conventional names. It is comparable to another dataset for snRNA-seq studies of bipolar cell subclasses.

labels.name: IMB
labels.rationale: This IMB type is annotated by the marker SLC35F4.

labels.name: FMB
labels.rationale: This FMB type is annotated by the marker SCG2.

labels.name: RB
labels.rationale: This RB type is annotated by the marker PRKCA.

labels.name: OFFx
labels.rationale: OFFx is annotated by FEZF1.

labels.name: DB2
labels.rationale: This DB2 type is annotated by COL5A1.

labels.name: DB1
labels.rationale: DB1 is annotated by EBF1.

labels.name: BB
labels.rationale: BB is annotated by SORCS3. PCDH11X is a marker for both GB and BB.

labels.name: DB5
labels.rationale: This DB5 is annotated by the marker MYO16.

labels.name: DB3a
labels.rationale: DB3a is annotated by DPP6.

labels.name: DB4a
labels.rationale: DB4a is a type of DB4, and it is annotated by TTR.

labels.name: DB3b
labels.rationale: DB3b is annotated by MEIS2.

labels.name: GB
labels.rationale: GB is annotated by AGBL1. PCDH11X is a marker for both GB and BB.

labels.name: DB6
labels.rationale: DB6 is annotated by LRRC4C.

labels.name: DB4b
labels.rationale: DB4b is a DB4 type, and it is annotated by PRSS12.

labelsets.name: cell_type
labelsets.description: The annotated cell type labels for bipolar types.

labels.name: invaginating midget bipolar cell
labels.rationale: This IMB type is annotated by the gene marker SLC35F4.

labels.name: flat midget bipolar cell
labels.rationale: This FMB type is annotated by marker SCG2.

labels.name: rod bipolar cell
labels.rationale: This RB type is annotated by marker PRKCA.

labels.name: OFFx cell
labels.rationale: OFFx is annotated by FEZF1.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 2 cell
labels.rationale: This DB2 type is annotated by marker COL5A1.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 1 cell
labels.rationale: The diffuse bipolar 1 (DB1) is annotated by the marker EBF1.

labels.name: ON-blue cone bipolar cell
labels.rationale: The cone-on blue bipolar (BB) is a rare cell type and annotated by the marker SORCS3. The marker PCDH11X is used for both giant bipolar and blue bipolar.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 5
labels.rationale: The diffuse bipolar 5 (DB5) is a bipolar type that does not have an existing Cell Ontology term. This term can be added to the Cell Ontology database. DB5 can be annodated by the marker MYO16.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 3a cell
labels.rationale: The diffuse bipolar 3a (DB3a) can be annotated by the marker DPP6.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 4 cell
labels.rationale: The diffuse bipolar 4 (DB4) has two types, DB4a and DB4b. Currently, there exists an Cell Ontology term for DB4, but not for DB4a and DB4b. Two Cell Onotology Terms can be added to the Cell Ontology database. DB4a can be annotated by the marker TTR, and DB4b can be annotated by the marker PRSS12.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 3b cell
labels.rationale: The diffuse bipolar 3b (DB3b) is annotated by MEIS2.

labels.name: giant bipolar cell
labels.rationale: The cone giant bipolar (GB) is annotated by the marker AGBL1. The marker PCDH11X is used for both giant bipolar and blue bipolar.

labels.name: diffuse bipolar 6 cell
labels.rationale: The diffuse bipolar 6 (DB6) is annotated by the marker LRRC4C.
